deskyard remote default: set or show the default remote

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] remote default [NAME]

Makes NAME the remote used when no -c or DESKYARD_REMOTE is given; without
NAME prints the current default.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      optional  remote name

Prints: without NAME: the default's name, or nothing

Examples:
  deskyard remote default alice

Where: on this machine (no remote needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
